## User Profile

The user is a TypeScript developer who builds small Node.js command-line tools and
prefers to review changes before anything is committed.

## User preferences

- “I always want node:test, zero dependencies and no semicolons.” -> default new Node projects to node:test, no runtime dependencies, and no semicolons [Task 1]
- “keep answers short” -> give concise completion reports
- “never commit or push without asking me first” -> require explicit authorization before git commit or push [Task 2]

## General Tips

- Run the project's own test script before reporting completion.
